annual mass of remembrance: for our parish will be celebrated in st. brigid’s church, dunleer on friday november 27th at 7.30pm. the sacraments of the anointing of the sick & confessions: will be celebrated after the 10am and the 7.30pm masses on saturday october 31st in st. brigid’s church, dunleer.
parish list of the dead: lists & envelopes are now available in our churches & parish office.
these can be returned via the mass collection, to the sacristy or to the parochial house ideally by friday october 30th.
mass is celebrated on each first friday throughout the year for all those on the parish list of the dead.
there is no requirement to include a monetary donation in the envelopes.

plenary indulgences in november: by long tradition, plenary indulgences for the souls of the departed may be gained in november as follows: from 12 noon on 1st november until midnight on 2nd november by visiting a church or oratory and there praying one our father and the apostle’s creed, one plenary indulgence, applicable only to the holy souls, may be gained, by all those who: have confessed (at any time within the week preceding or the week following 1st november) received holy communion (any day from 1-8 nov) prayed for the pope’s intentions (one our father and hail mary or any other prayer of one’s choice) from 1st — 8th november the faithful who visit a cemetery and pray for the dead may gain one plenary indulgence, applicable only to the holy souls.
the above conditions regarding confession, holy communion and prayer for the pope’s intentions apply also for this.
